name: ULW Match Sample: Lover Boy vs. Dan McCain

matches.stipulation: Best two-out-of-three falls, No DQ; World Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: Lover Boy defeated champion Dan McCain by submission (a Texas cloverleaf) in the third fall to win the title, after McCain took the first fall and Lover Boy leveled the match in the second with his own finisher.

notes: A ULW-branded (pre-rebrand) writing sample posted alongside EULW's own relaunch; the World Heavyweight title changes hands.
